title: Calendar subscription
intro: See your lessons in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. Your calendar updates by itself when lessons change.
copyFallback: Press Ctrl+C (⌘C on Mac) to copy.
secret: Anyone with this link can see your lessons. Don't share it. If it leaks, reset it.

contents.title: What's in it
contents.range: Your lessons from 30 days ago to 6 months ahead
contents.notAttending: Lessons you reported you'll miss, marked "Not attending"

howTo.title: How to add it
howTo.google: Google Calendar: copy the link. On a computer, open Google Calendar, next to "Other calendars" click +, choose "From URL", paste the link and click "Add calendar".
howTo.apple: Apple Calendar: on your iPhone or Mac, tap "Subscribe on this device" and confirm.
howTo.outlook: Outlook: copy the link. In Outlook on the web, go to "Add calendar", choose "Subscribe from web", paste the link and save.

refreshNote: Calendar apps check for changes every few hours, so a change can take a while to show up.

reset.title: Reset your calendar link?
reset.description: Your current link stops working right away. Calendars that use it will stop updating, so you'll need to add the new link to them.
reset.addNew: New link created. Add it to your calendar apps.

error.create: Couldn't create your calendar link. Try again.
error.reset: Couldn't reset your calendar link. Your current link still works.

revokedByAdmin: The school turned off your previous link. Create a new one to keep your calendar up to date.

revoke.title: Turn off {name}'s calendar link?
revoke.description: Their calendar apps stop updating. They can create a new link themselves.
